Retrieve the seller's dashboard summary with shop performance metrics

This endpoint provides sellers with a comprehensive overview of their shop activity. The dashboard displays key statistics including:

- Total number of products in the seller's catalog.
- Total number of order items purchased from the seller's products.
- Number of pending cancellation requests that require the seller's response.
- Number of pending refund requests that require the seller's response.

Sellers can use this dashboard to quickly identify items requiring attention and monitor their shop's overall performance. The data is scoped to the authenticated seller and excludes information belonging to other sellers.
operations.name: at
operations.specification:
Query and aggregate data for the authenticated seller's dashboard:

1. Product Count: Count products where product.sellerId equals the authenticated seller's ID.
2. Order Item Count: Count order items where orderItem.sellerId equals the authenticated seller's ID.
3. Pending Cancellation Requests: Count cancellation requests where:
   - The orderItem.sellerId matches the authenticated seller
   - The cancellation request status is 'pending'
4. Pending Refund Requests: Count refund requests where:
   - The orderItem.sellerId matches the authenticated seller
   - The refund request status is 'pending'

The seller is identified from the authentication context (session/JWT token). No input parameters are required as the dashboard is always for the currently authenticated seller.

Error handling:
- 401: If the caller is not authenticated or not a seller

responseBody.description: Seller dashboard summary containing shop performance statistics

operations.description:
Search and list order item records with pagination and filtering capabilities.

This endpoint allows authorized users (sellers viewing their order items, customers viewing their purchased items, administrators viewing all) to retrieve a paginated list of order items. Order items represent individual purchased product variants within an order.

Supports filtering by:
- Order status (Paid, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled, Refunded)
- Order ID
- Product ID
- Seller ID
- Customer ID
- Date ranges

The response includes summary information suitable for list displays, showing product names, quantities, prices, and current status. Pagination uses offset/limit pattern for flexible navigation through large result sets.

Related operations:
- Individual order item retrieval: GET /order-items/{orderItemId}
- Order creation: POST /orders
operations.name: index
operations.specification:
Query the ecommerce_mall_order_items table with pagination and filtering support.

**Implementation Steps:**
1. Validate user permissions based on actor type:
   - Customers: filter by their own customerId only
   - Sellers: filter by their own sellerId only  
   - Admins/SuperAdmins: can filter by any criteria

2. Apply filters from request body:
   - orderId: filter items belonging to specific order
   - productId: filter items for specific product
   - sellerId: filter items for specific seller (admin only)
   - status: filter by item status (PAID, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED, REFUNDED)
   - orderDateFrom/To: date range filtering

3. Join with related tables for display data:
   - ecommerce_mall_products: get product name
   - ecommerce_mall_product_variants: get variant info
   - ecommerce_mall_orders: get order date and customer info

4. Return paginated results with:
   - Total count for pagination
   - Order item summaries with product/variant names
   - Current status and timestamps
   - Price and quantity information

**Edge Cases:**
- Empty result set when no items match filters
- Respect data isolation: customers cannot see other customers' order items
- Respect data isolation: sellers cannot see other sellers' order items

responseBody.description: Paginated list of order item summaries

requestBody.description: Search criteria and pagination parameters for filtering order items

operations.description:
Search and browse products with comprehensive filtering and pagination.

This endpoint enables customers to discover products across all sellers. It supports full-text search by product name with partial matching, category-based filtering for both parent categories and subcategories, price range filters, and stock availability filtering.

Products are automatically filtered to exclude deleted products regardless of search criteria. Products without any variants are included in results but marked as unavailable for purchase. Similarly, products with only out-of-stock variants are marked accordingly.

Search results can be sorted by newest first, price low-to-high, or price high-to-low. Results are paginated and include summary information optimized for list displays: main thumbnail image, product name, base price or price range, seller shop name, and average customer rating.

Related operations include viewing product details via GET /products/{productId} and managing wishlist items.
operations.name: index
operations.specification:
Query ecommerce_mall_products table joining with ecommerce_mall_categories for category filtering, ecommerce_mall_sellers and ecommerce_mall_seller_profiles for seller information, and ecommerce_mall_product_variants for availability checks.

Apply mandatory filter: deleted_at IS NULL to exclude deleted products per section 336.

Apply optional filters from request body:
- name: partial match using GIN trigram index on name column
- categoryId: filter by exact category match
- minPrice/maxPrice: filter by base_price range
- inStockOnly: when true, only include products with at least one variant having positive current stock (computed from inventory_records)

Sorting options:
- newest: ORDER BY created_at DESC
- price_asc: ORDER BY base_price ASC
- price_desc: ORDER BY base_price DESC

Pagination: cursor-based with configurable page size.

Response construction:
- mainImage: first image (display_order=0) from ecommerce_mall_product_images
- priceRange: computed from MIN/MAX of variant prices (including those using base_price when variant.price IS NULL)
- sellerShopName: from joined ecommerce_mall_seller_profiles
- averageRating: computed from ecommerce_mall_reviews for this product
- availabilityStatus: 'available' if at least one variant with stock>0, 'unavailable' if no variants or all out of stock

Include total count for pagination metadata.

responseBody.description: Paginated list of product summaries with search metadata

requestBody.description: Search criteria including text search, category filters, price range, stock availability, sorting, and pagination parameters

operations.description:

This operation returns comprehensive product information including all images, category details, seller shop information, available variants with prices and stock status, and customer reviews. The first image in the sequence serves as the main thumbnail.

Products without any variants are displayed but marked as unavailable for purchase. Out-of-stock variants are visually distinguished from available variants. The response includes the average customer rating and total review count calculated from all non-deleted reviews.

If the product has been deleted (soft-deleted), it will not be returned. This endpoint is accessible to authenticated customers.
operations.name: at
operations.specification:
Query the ecommerce_mall_products table by id where deleted_at is null.

Fetch the following related data:
1. Product images from ecommerce_mall_product_images ordered by display_order ascending
2. Category details from ecommerce_mall_categories (name, description)
3. Seller information from ecommerce_mall_sellers joined with ecommerce_mall_seller_profiles (shop_name, logo_image_url, shop_description)
4. All product variants from ecommerce_mall_product_variants where deleted_at is null
5. For each variant, calculate current stock by summing quantities from ecommerce_mall_inventory_records
6. All reviews from ecommerce_mall_reviews where deleted_at is null, ordered by created_at descending
7. Calculate average rating and review count from non-deleted reviews

Return a 404 error if the product does not exist or is deleted.
Return all data in a single response with nested relations.

responseBody.description: Complete product detail including images, category, seller info, variants with stock status, and reviews

operations.description:
Compare two snapshots of a product to identify differences between versions.

This operation enables detailed comparison of product states at different points in time, showing exactly what fields were modified, added, or removed.

The comparison includes:
- Product-level fields: name, description, category assignment, base price
- Product images: additions, removals, reordering
- Product variants: SKU code changes, option value modifications, price adjustments

Access control:
- Sellers can compare snapshots of their own products
- Administrators can compare snapshots of any product on the platform

The response highlights differences with before/after values for each changed field. This supports dispute resolution by providing clear evidence of what product information was displayed at specific times.
operations.name: compare
operations.specification:
Retrieve the two specified product snapshots from ecommerce_mall_product_snapshots table by productId and snapshotId parameters.

If sourceSnapshotId is provided but targetSnapshotId is null, compare the source snapshot with the current product state from ecommerce_mall_products table.

If both snapshot IDs are provided, load both snapshots from the snapshot table and compare them.

Perform deep comparison on:
- Product fields: name, description, category_id, base_price
- Images: compare arrays for additions, deletions, order changes
- Variants: compare SKU codes, option_values, and prices

Return a structured diff object showing field-level changes with old_value and new_value for each modification.

Authorization check: Verify requester owns the product (seller) or has administrator privileges.

responseBody.description: Comparison result showing differences between two product snapshots

operations.description:
Compare two snapshots of a product variant to identify differences.

This operation retrieves two specific snapshots of a product variant and returns a detailed comparison showing what changed between them. The comparison includes differences in SKU code, price, and option values.

Sellers can compare snapshots of their own product variants to track changes over time. Administrators can compare snapshots of any variant on the platform. This supports audit trails and dispute resolution by enabling users to see exactly what changed between any two points in time.

Snapshots are immutable records (Section 281) that preserve the complete state of a variant at a specific moment. Every edit to a variant (Section 212, 493) creates a snapshot recording the previous state including SKU code, option values, and price.
operations.name: compare
operations.specification:
Validate that the variant exists and is accessible to the requesting user (sellers can only access their own variants, administrators can access any).

Validate that both snapshot IDs reference snapshots belonging to the specified variant.

Retrieve both snapshots from ecommerce_mall_product_variant_snapshots with their related optionValues from ecommerce_mall_product_variant_snapshot_option_values.

Calculate the differences between the two snapshots:
- Compare sku_code field
- Compare price field
- Compare optionValues (key-value pairs) - identify added, removed, or changed options

Return the comparison result including both snapshot timestamps and the detected differences. The comparison should show before/after values for each changed field.

operations.description:
Check if the authenticated customer can write a review for a specific order item.

This endpoint verifies the eligibility conditions for submitting a product review. A review can only be written when three conditions are met:

1. The order item exists and belongs to the authenticated customer
2. The order item status is 'delivered', confirming the customer has received the product
3. No review has already been submitted for this order item

The endpoint returns an eligibility flag that the frontend can use to enable or disable the review submission interface. Customers can only write one review per order item per the unique constraint on order_item_id in the reviews table.

Related operations:
- POST /order-items/{orderItemId}/reviews - Submit a review (available only when this endpoint returns eligible: true)
- GET /orders/{orderId}/order-items - List order items to find reviewable products
operations.name: at
operations.specification:
1. Extract orderItemId from path parameter (UUID format)
2. Authenticate the customer and extract customer_id from session/token
3. Query ecommerce_mall_order_items table where id = orderItemId
4. Check ownership: order_item.customer_id must match authenticated customer_id - return unauthorized error if mismatch
5. Check if order_item.status = 'delivered' - if not, return { eligible: false, reason: 'ITEM_NOT_DELIVERED' }
6. Check if a review exists: query ecommerce_mall_reviews where order_item_id = orderItemId
7. If review exists, return { eligible: false, reason: 'REVIEW_ALREADY_EXISTS' }
8. If all checks pass, return { eligible: true }

Security: Verify customer ownership of the order item before returning any information. Log access attempts for audit purposes.

Edge cases:
- Order item not found: return 404 Not Found
- Order item belongs to different customer: return 403 Forbidden
- Order item soft-deleted (deleted_at set): treat as not found
- Order status is 'paid' or 'shipped': not eligible, reason = 'ITEM_NOT_DELIVERED'
- Order status is 'cancelled' or 'refunded': not eligible, reason = 'ORDER_CANCELLED_OR_REFUNDED'

responseBody.description: Eligibility status indicating whether the customer can submit a review for this order item. When eligible is true, the review submission endpoint is available. When false, the reason field explains why.

operations.description:
Retrieve a filtered and paginated list of deleted (soft-deleted) products for administrative oversight.

This operation allows administrators to browse products that have been removed from active listings through soft deletion. Deleted products remain in the database with their deleted_at timestamp populated, preserving referential integrity with historical orders and snapshots.

Administrators can filter by product name, seller, category, and deletion date range. This supports audit workflows, dispute resolution, and recovery planning. Deleted products retain all their original data and can be viewed in full detail via the product snapshot history.

Products cascade to remove variants and inventory records upon deletion, but order history is preserved through order item snapshots.

Query ecommerce_mall_products table where deleted_at IS NOT NULL.

Join with ecommerce_mall_sellers to get seller shop name information.
Join with ecommerce_mall_categories to get category names.

Support filters:
- name: partial text match using GIN index on name(ops: gin_trgm_ops)
- seller_id: exact match filter
- category_id: exact match filter
- deleted_at_from / deleted_at_to: date range filtering on deletion timestamp

Support sorting:
- deleted_at: DESC (newest deletions first) or ASC
- created_at: DESC or ASC
- name: ASC or DESC

Return paginated results with:
- Product ID, name, description, base_price
- Category ID and name
- Seller ID and shop name (from seller profile)
- created_at, updated_at, deleted_at timestamps
- Snapshot count for the product

Use cursor-based or offset pagination with configurable page size (default 20, max 100).

Authorization: Admin or SuperAdmin only. Regular sellers and customers cannot access this endpoint.

Retrieve a filtered and paginated list of archived (soft-deleted) seller accounts.

This operation allows administrators to view seller accounts that have been deleted by the sellers themselves. Archived sellers remain in the system to preserve order history and snapshots for legal and compliance purposes.

Supports filtering by deletion date range, original approval status, and email address. Results are ordered by deletion date (newest first) by default. Only sellers with deleted_at timestamp set are included in the results.

This is an admin-only operation requiring administrator authentication.

- email: Partial email matching (LIKE %email%)

Join with ecommerce_mall_seller_registrations to get registration status context if needed.

Return paginated results with cursor-based pagination. Include summary fields: id, email, approval_status, created_at, deleted_at.

Sort by deleted_at DESC (newest deletions first) by default.

operations.description:
Retrieve review statistics for a specific product, including average rating, total review count, and rating distribution breakdown.

This endpoint provides aggregated review data suitable for product listing pages and statistics displays. The average rating is calculated from all non-deleted reviews for the product, expressed as a numeric value from 1.0 to 5.0 with one decimal precision.

The key statistics returned include:
- Average rating: The arithmetic mean of all non-deleted review ratings
- Total review count: The number of reviews (non-deleted) contributing to the average
- Rating distribution: A breakdown showing how many reviews fall into each star rating (1-5 stars)

This data is used to display star ratings, review counts, and distribution charts on product detail pages. Snapshots of deleted reviews are excluded from the calculation as they are preserved for audit purposes but not considered in the average rating.

Related operations:
- GET /products/{productId}/reviews - Retrieve the actual review content and details
- GET /products/{productId} - Product detail which may include basic rating summary
operations.name: reviewStats
operations.specification:
Query the ecommerce_mall_reviews table filtered by product_id and where deleted_at is null. Calculate the average rating and count. Also query the distribution of ratings grouped by rating value (1-5). 

Return an object containing:
- averageRating: float rounded to 1 decimal place (calculated from non-deleted reviews)
- totalCount: integer count of non-deleted reviews for this product
- distribution: object with keys '1', '2', '3', '4', '5' representing count of reviews for each star rating

The endpoint is read-only and must support efficient caching since product statistics are frequently accessed. Consider implementing materialized view or caching strategy for common products. If the product has no reviews, return averageRating of 0 and totalCount of 0 with all distribution counts at 0.

responseBody.description: Review statistics including average rating, total count, and rating distribution

- averageRating: float rounded to 1 decimal place (calculated from non-deleted reviews)

- distribution: object with keys '1', '2', '3', '4', '5' representing count of reviews for each star rating

The endpoint is read-only and must support efficient caching since product statistics are frequently accessed. Consider implementing materialized view or caching strategy for common products. operations.description:
Retrieve review statistics for a specific product, including average rating, total review count, and rating distribution breakdown.

This endpoint provides aggregated review data suitable for product listing pages and statistics displays. The average rating is calculated from all non-deleted reviews for the product, expressed as a numeric value from 1.0 to 5.0 with one decimal precision.

The key statistics returned include:
- Average rating: The arithmetic mean of all non-deleted review ratings
- Total review count: The number of reviews (non-deleted) contributing to the average
- Rating distribution: A breakdown showing how many reviews fall into each star rating (1-5 stars)

This data is used to display star ratings, review counts, and distribution charts on product detail pages. Snapshots of deleted reviews are excluded from the calculation as they are preserved for audit purposes but not considered in the average rating.

Related operations:
- GET /products/{productId}/reviews - Retrieve the actual review content and details
- GET /products/{productId} - Product detail which may include basic rating summary

operations.description:
Retrieve the count of pending administrator promotion requests.

This endpoint provides super administrators with a quick count of how many pending promotion requests are awaiting their review. It is designed for dashboard widgets and notification badges where only the count is needed, not the full request details.

The count includes all AdminPromotionRequest entities with 'pending' status, representing user requests to become administrators that have not yet been approved or rejected.
operations.name: pendingRequestsCount
operations.specification:
Query the ecommerce_mall_admin_promotion_requests table and count records where status equals 'pending'. 

This is a read-only aggregation operation that performs a simple COUNT query with a WHERE clause filtering for pending status. The operation should be extremely lightweight, executing a single database aggregate query.

Implementation notes:
1. Execute: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce_mall_admin_promotion_requests WHERE status = 'pending'
2. Return the count as a numeric value
3. No authorization checks beyond ensuring the caller is a super administrator
4. No pagination or filtering needed - this returns a single scalar value

access.description:

This token must be included in the Authorization header using the Bearer
scheme (e.g., `Authorization: Bearer {access}`) for all endpoints requiring

session renewal capabilities.

credentials. This structure is automatically included in authentication
responses across all generated backend applications.

basePriceNew.x-autobe-specification: Extracted from the target snapshot's base_price field (ecommerce_mall_product_snapshots.base_price) or current product state (ecommerce_mall_products.base_price) if targetSnapshotId is null. Null if the base price was not modified between snapshots.

imagesAdded.description: Array of images that were added to the product between the source and target snapshots. Empty array if no images were added.
imagesAdded.x-autobe-specification: Computed by comparing the image arrays between source and target snapshots. Images present in the target (ecommerce_mall_product_snapshot_images joined to target snapshot) but not in the source are included here. Uses IEcommerceMallProductSnapshotImage.ISummary type for each added image, containing id, url, display_order, and created_at.

imagesRemoved.description: Array of images that were removed from the product between the source and target snapshots. Empty array if no images were removed.
imagesRemoved.x-autobe-specification: Computed by comparing the image arrays between source and target snapshots. Images present in the source (ecommerce_mall_product_snapshot_images joined to source snapshot) but not in the target are included here. Uses IEcommerceMallProductSnapshotImage.ISummary type for each removed image, containing id, url, display_order, and created_at.

imagesReordered.description: Array of image identifiers (UUIDs) whose display order changed between snapshots. Empty array if no images were reordered.
imagesReordered.x-autobe-specification: Computed by comparing display_order values of images present in both source and target snapshots. Contains UUID identifiers of images from ecommerce_mall_product_snapshot_images where the display_order field differs between snapshots.

variantsChanged.description: Array of variant identifiers (UUIDs) that underwent changes between snapshots. Empty array if no variants were modified.
variantsChanged.x-autobe-specification: Computed by comparing product variant snapshots between source and target. Includes variant snapshot UUID identifiers from ecommerce_mall_product_variant_snapshots where SKU code, option values, or prices differ between the two snapshots.

IEcommerceMallProductSnapshotComparison.description: Comparison result showing differences between two product snapshots, including product field changes, image modifications, and variant updates. Used for dispute resolution by providing clear evidence of what product information was displayed at specific times.
IEcommerceMallProductSnapshotComparison.x-autobe-specification: Computed type aggregating comparison results from two product snapshots or one snapshot + current product state. Retrieve source snapshot from ecommerce_mall_product_snapshots by sourceSnapshotId. If targetSnapshotId is provided, retrieve target snapshot from same table; otherwise use current product state from ecommerce_mall_products. Perform deep comparison on: product fields (name, description, category_id, base_price), images (compare arrays for additions, deletions, order changes using IEcommerceMallProductSnapshotImage.ISummary), and variants (compare SKU codes, option_values, and prices). Changed scalar fields show both old and new values; unchanged fields show null. Arrays track added/removed/reordered items. Return structured diff object for dispute resolution and audit purposes.

totalProducts.description: Total number of active products currently listed by this seller.
totalProducts.x-autobe-specification: Count of products in ecommerce_mall_products table where ecommerce_mall_seller_id matches the authenticated seller ID. Excludes soft-deleted products.

totalOrderItems.description: Total number of order items purchased across all of this seller's products.
totalOrderItems.x-autobe-specification: Count of order items in ecommerce_mall_order_items table joined with ecommerce_mall_products on product_id where the product's ecommerce_mall_seller_id matches authenticated seller ID.

pendingCancellationRequests.description: Total number of pending cancellation requests awaiting seller response for this seller's order items.
pendingCancellationRequests.x-autobe-specification: Count of cancellation requests in ecommerce_mall_cancellation_requests table with status PENDING, joined through ecommerce_mall_order_items to filter by seller ownership.

pendingRefundRequests.description: Total number of pending refund requests awaiting seller response for this seller's delivered order items.
pendingRefundRequests.x-autobe-specification: Count of refund requests in ecommerce_mall_refund_requests table with status PENDING, joined through ecommerce_mall_order_items to filter by seller ownership.

IEcommerceMallSellerDashboard.description: Seller dashboard providing aggregated business metrics including product counts, order statistics, and pending request summaries for the authenticated seller account.
IEcommerceMallSellerDashboard.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation querying multiple tables filtered by authenticated seller ID. Queries ecommerce_mall_products for totalProducts, ecommerce_mall_order_items joined with products for totalOrderItems, ecommerce_mall_cancellation_requests joined with order_items for pendingCancellationRequests, and ecommerce_mall_refund_requests joined with order_items for pendingRefundRequests. Only includes PENDING status for request counts.

maxPrice.x-autobe-specification: Maximum price boundary for product search filtering. Applied as upper bound on variant price in search queries.

IEcommerceMallProduct.IPriceRange.x-autobe-specification: Utility DTO for product price range filtering. Used in product search request bodies to specify price boundaries. minPrice and maxPrice are filter parameters applied against product_variant.price or product.basePrice in search queries.

createdAt.description: Date and time when this snapshot was created, marking when the state transition occurred.
createdAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_mall_admin_promotion_request_snapshots.created_at. Timestamp when this snapshot was captured (when the state change occurred).

adminPromotionRequest.description: Summary of the parent administrator promotion request associated with this snapshot.
adminPromotionRequest.x-autobe-specification: Join via ecommerce_mall_admin_promotion_request_snapshots.admin_promotion_request_id to ecommerce_mall_admin_promotion_requests.id. Returns IEcommerceMallAdminPromotionRequest.ISummary with request details.

reviewedBySuperAdmin.description: Summary of the super administrator who processed this state change, or null if not yet reviewed.
reviewedBySuperAdmin.x-autobe-specification: Join via ecommerce_mall_admin_promotion_request_snapshots.new_reviewer_id to ecommerce_mall_super_admins.id. Returns IEcommerceMallSuperAdmin.ISummary or null if not reviewed yet. Maps to 'newReviewer' relation in DB schema, exposed as reviewedBySuperAdmin for semantic clarity.

IEcommerceMallAdminPromotionRequestSnaps.description: Immutable snapshot capturing an administrator promotion request state transition at a specific point in time. Preserves the complete state after review including the new status, reviewing super administrator identity, review reason, and associated promotion request details. Part of an audit trail for tracking privilege changes on the platform.
IEcommerceMallAdminPromotionRequestSnaps.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_mall_admin_promotion_request_snapshots table with joined relations. Captures state transition at the moment of super admin review. Each property maps: id (PK), admin_promotion_request_id (FK to parent request), previous_status (state before), new_status (state after - exposed as currentStatus), new_reviewer_id (super admin who reviewed - exposed as reviewedBySuperAdminId), new_reason (review explanation - exposed as reason), created_at (timestamp). Joins: adminPromotionRequest relation via admin_promotion_request_id to IEcommerceMallAdminPromotionRequest.ISummary, newReviewer relation via new_reviewer_id to IEcommerceMallSuperAdmin.ISummary. Previous snapshot stores prior state; this snapshot represents the NEW state after transition.

When updating, the system automatically resequences other images to maintain gap-free ordering from 0. First image (0) serves as the main thumbnail.

IEcommerceMallProductImage.IUpdate.description: Request body for updating a product image's display order to reorder images within a product.
IEcommerceMallProductImage.IUpdate.x-autobe-specification: Request body DTO for updating a product image's display order. Maps to ecommerce_mall_product_images table. Only display_order is mutable by users; all other fields are either structural (id, product_id), immutable (image_url - requires delete+create workflow), or system-managed (timestamps). The display_order value must be a non-negative integer within the valid range (0 to current image count - 1).

createdAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_mall_shipment_items.created_at. Timestamptz field automatically set when the shipment-item association is created.

IEcommerceMallShipmentItem.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_mall_shipment_items table. id maps to id column, createdAt maps to created_at column. orderItem maps to orderItem relation via order_item_id FK joined to ecommerce_mall_order_items with nested product, variant, and seller details. createdAt.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created, indicating when the registration state was recorded.
createdAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_mall_seller_registration_snapshots.created_at. Timestamp when this snapshot was created, representing the exact moment the registration state was captured.

sellerRegistration.x-autobe-specification: JOIN via ecommerce_mall_seller_registration_snapshots.ecommerce_mall_seller_registration_id to ecommerce_mall_seller_registrations.id. Returns IEcommerceMallSellerRegistration.ISummary with the parent registration details. This relation provides context for which registration this snapshot belongs to.

IEcommerceMallSellerRegistrationSnapshot.description: Lightweight summary of a seller registration snapshot capturing the registration state at a specific point in time, including status, review outcome, and reference to the parent registration.
IEcommerceMallSellerRegistrationSnapshot.x-autobe-specification: Snapshot table with columns: id, created_at, ecommerce_mall_seller_registration_id, ecommerce_mall_admin_id. Relations: registration (parent registration), reviewer (admin who reviewed). Status and rejectionReason are computed/denormalized by JOINing to parent registration at snapshot time.

path.description: The dot-notation path identifying which property changed, supporting nested objects and array indices.
path.x-autobe-specification: Computed: Dot-notation path to the changed property within the entity structure (e.g., 'name', 'category.name', 'variants.0.price'). Parsed from the field difference detection algorithm during snapshot comparison.

operation.description: The type of change operation performed: ADDED, REMOVED, MODIFIED, or UNCHANGED.
operation.x-autobe-specification: Computed: Change operation type determined by comparing old and new values - 'ADDED' when field exists only in new, 'REMOVED' when only in old, 'MODIFIED' when both exist but differ, 'UNCHANGED' when equal.

oldValue.description: The previous value before the change, serialized as a string. Null for newly added properties.
oldValue.x-autobe-specification: Computed: Serialized string representation of the property's value from the older snapshot. Null when the property didn't exist (ADDED operation) or when unchanged. Uses JSON serialization for complex types.

newValue.description: The new value after the change, serialized as a string. Null for removed properties.
newValue.x-autobe-specification: Computed: Serialized string representation of the property's value from the newer snapshot. Null when the property was removed (REMOVED operation). Uses JSON serialization for complex types.

message.description: Human-readable message describing the change in natural language for audit logs and UI displays.
message.x-autobe-specification: Computed: Human-readable description of the change generated from path, operation, and values. Format: '{path} was {operation}: {oldValue} → {newValue}' or similar descriptive text based on operation type.

IDifferenceEntry.description: Represents a single field-level difference between two entity snapshots, capturing the property path, change operation, old and new values, and human-readable message for audit and comparison displays.
IDifferenceEntry.x-autobe-specification: Computed type generated by comparing two snapshot states. Each instance represents one changed field: path uses dot notation for nested properties, operation indicates the change type (ADDED, REMOVED, MODIFIED, UNCHANGED), oldValue and newValue preserve the serialized values at each state, and message provides a human-readable description of the change. Not stored in database - generated on-the-fly during snapshot comparison operations.

IEcommerceMallProductVariantSnapshotOpti.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_mall_product_variant_snapshot_option_values table. type.description: Type discriminator indicating which value property contains the actual snapshot data.
type.x-autobe-specification: Discriminator field indicating the actual data type stored. Valid values: 'string', 'number', 'boolean', 'object', 'array'. Determines which value property contains the populated data.

stringValue.description: String value of the snapshot datum, populated when type discriminator is 'string'.
stringValue.x-autobe-specification: Populated when 'type' discriminator equals 'string'. Contains the actual string value extracted from the snapshot field. Null or undefined when type indicates other data types.

numberValue.description: Numeric value of the snapshot datum, populated when type discriminator is 'number'.
numberValue.x-autobe-specification: Populated when 'type' discriminator equals 'number'. Contains the actual numeric value (integer or decimal) extracted from the snapshot field. Null or undefined when type indicates other data types.

booleanValue.description: Boolean value of the snapshot datum, populated when type discriminator is 'boolean'.
booleanValue.x-autobe-specification: Populated when 'type' discriminator equals 'boolean'. Contains the actual boolean value extracted from the snapshot field. Null or undefined when type indicates other data types.

objectValueJson.description: Object value of the snapshot datum, populated when type discriminator is 'object'. Contains structured key-value data.
objectValueJson.x-autobe-specification: Populated when 'type' discriminator equals 'object'. Contains the object value (key-value pairs) extracted from the snapshot field, parsed from JSON storage. Null or undefined when type indicates other data types.

arrayValueJson.description: Array value of the snapshot datum, populated when type discriminator is 'array'. Contains ordered list data.
arrayValueJson.x-autobe-specification: Populated when 'type' discriminator equals 'array'. Contains the array value extracted from the snapshot field, parsed from JSON storage. Null or undefined when type indicates other data types.

ISnapshotDatum.description: Polymorphic value container representing a single datum (field value) extracted from entity snapshots during comparison operations. Supports scalar types (string, number, boolean) and complex types (object, array) with a discriminator-based access pattern.
ISnapshotDatum.x-autobe-specification: Utility type representing polymorphic field values extracted from entity snapshots during comparison operations. The 'type' discriminator determines which value property (stringValue, numberValue, booleanValue, objectValueJson, or arrayValueJson) contains the populated data. Used within IDifferenceEntry to represent old and new values when comparing entity states.
